head.title: The core knows what a secret is. Something has to go and get the text.
lede: Six packages that fetch text, hand it to the core and carry the answer back.

theProblemItSolves.title: A copied example is a fork you now own
theProblemItSolves.intro: The core repository ships worked examples of wiring a logger or a tracer into the scanner. You could copy the file. From that moment you owned it: no version, no changelog, no notice when the host SDK's contract moved, and no way for the project to fix wiring it had written itself.
